name: ca77y-agentic
description: Personal agentic toolkit: an idea-to-shipped development pipeline and a research-library crew, as two independently installable plugins of native Claude Code subagents.

plugins.name: ca77y-engineering
plugins.description: Idea-to-shipped development pipeline: analyst, lead, writer, coder, qa, auditor, plus the board skill. One task in, one PR out. Uses ca77y-library when it is installed; works without it.

plugins.name: ca77y-library
plugins.description: Research-library crew: researcher, librarian, scribe, clerk. Grows and maintains a project's Markdown research library in place. Standalone — installable with or without ca77y-engineering.
